_note: Read 17 September 2026 from imandevelopers.com. The site pops up a name/email/phone enquiry form on load and the brochure is behind it - I did not fill it in and did not fetch anything behind it; the popup artwork /assets/images/popup/popupimg.jpg is excluded as furniture. Images are served from the developer's own WordPress backend at api.imandevelopers.com. The small amenity PNGs under /uploads/2025/04/ and /2025/05/ (Rooftop-Gym.png etc.) were measured at around 90x68 and are pictogram icons, so they are excluded. I downloaded and LOOKED at every image listed here. FILENAME WARNINGS: exterior-4-1 is an aerial of the amenity pool deck and exterior-5-1 is a view OUT from a resident's terrace over the skyline - neither is a picture of the building. And one-sky-park-2.jpg, the file named after the project, is a photograph of the live construction site with tower cranes, not a render. No floor plans are published as images on this page.
